name: Yuzuki Suzune
source:
The younger of the sisters, she is calm but determined. She is a very clever and manipulative girl, who pretends to be well behaved while setting up naughty events.

She likes to push the protagonist around all whilst pretending to not know a thing just so she can get closer to him.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/MEH-008/]official site[/url]]
